summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating on the Ebola outbreak and development of opaganib. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing merely provides clinical and partnership updates regarding a therapeutic candidate. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer of the press release. There are no deal terms, advisor recommendations, or structural changes to analyze. What to watch: None, as this is a status report on outbreak response, not a corporate transaction.
